spec_match.rationale: Enumerates the spec's built-in navigating URL attributes list entry by entry — a/area/base href, SVG a href/xlink:href, MathML href, button/input formaction, form action, iframe src, plus the SVG-animation case implicitly via the list copy — and runs each through the real sanitizer in both policy modes.

interactive.rationale: A run button executes 22 real setHTMLUnsafe calls (11 fixtures × 2 policies) and fills the matrix from the resulting DOM; the verdict line aggregates counts computed from those results.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises every list entry plus a non-navigating counter-example in both modes; the table has exactly those rows and columns.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers element-removed and exception outcomes per cell, the identical-columns state on pre-157 builds (named as the ignored-unknown-member legacy path), the surprising identical-with-mutator state, and the img src scope counter-example.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5169798320357376 and whatwg/html#12898; the code-path section shows the exact strip/keep calls.

conformance.rationale: The suite's false-strips / true-keeps / non-navigating-untouched assertions are the same contracts as three of the matrix's columns/rows.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with --enable-blink-features=SanitizerAPI via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): all 11 rows filled, both columns identical with every attr kept (the documented pre-157 unsafe-method behavior) and the verdict naming the ignored-option cause; zero console errors; the kept javascript: img fixture was made loading=lazy after a first pass surfaced an attempted fetch of the javascript: URL, and the re-run was network-clean; 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: the strip column requires a 157+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: sanitizer-matrix-ran asserts the full row count and sanitizer-matrix-counter-example-untouched asserts the scope contract; the no-API branch has its own assert.

design_system.rationale: Cell colors (emerald stripped / rose kept / muted gone) sit on bg-paper at AA; the muted state also differs in wording, not color alone.

accessibility.rationale: Caption + scoped-header table in an overflow wrapper, native run button, verdict as aria-live=polite output, cell meanings carried by text ('attr kept', 'attr stripped'), not color alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read; the four-column table scrolls inside .table-wrap on narrow widths.

openQuestions.title: Capture the diverging matrix on Chrome 157+
openQuestions.detail: On a 157+ build, verify the javascriptURLs: false column strips all ten navigating fixtures while true keeps them, img src stays untouched in both, and base href behaves per the list (base is a navigating-attribute entry).

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitizer API custom configuration attribute handling
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Treat sanitizer behavior as config-driven and verify against the real API rather than documentation claims.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every cell is produced by a real setHTMLUnsafe call at render time; no row is hard-coded, so the matrix is this browser's actual behavior.

guidanceConsulted.query: large data matrix table mobile overflow accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep semantic table structure in a scrolling wrapper rather than reflowing into divs; state must not be color-only.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Table keeps caption/th scope inside .table-wrap with overflow-x: auto; every cell carries verdict text alongside its color.

summary: Edge matrix: all built-in navigating URL attribute entries plus an img src counter-example through the real sanitizer in both policy modes. Driven on flag-enabled headless Chromium 141 (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): identical keep-columns correctly attributed to the unimplemented option, counter-example untouched, clean console, network-clean after the lazy-img fix, 0px overflow both classes.
